Labo abangakholwa kwabeMibhalo kanye namaMushrikina [ababhanqi] abasoze bayeka [ukholo lwabo] kuze kuba kufika ubufakazi.
ISithunywa sika Allah esibafundela Imiqulu Ehlanzekile.
Laba abanikwa iMibhalo, bahlakazeka emuva kokuba sekufike kubo imibiko ecacile.
Futhi babekade beyalelwe ukuba bakhonze u Allah ngokuzinikela okumsulwa bengambhangqi nalutho, futhi baqikelele ukwenza iSwala nokukhipha iZaka; bheka ngoba iyona leyo inkolo eqotho [i-Isilamu].
Nebala, labo abangakholwa kwabeMibhalo namaMushirikina bayongena eMlilwe wase Jahanamu babhadle kuwo unaphakade; yiboke kanye labo abayindalo embi.
Kepha labo abakholwayo nabenza okulungileyo, yibona abayindalo enhle.

Umvuzo wabo oseNkosini yabo izivande zaseDeni okugeleza enzansi kwazo imifula, bayohlala kuzo unaphakade; u Allah uthokozile ngabo kanti nabo bathokozile ngo Allah. Lokho okumuntu owesaba iNkosi yakho.
